title: Level 2/3 Sound Healing Course at Bali Yoga School
metaTitle: Level 2/3 Sound Healing Course in Bali Indonesia
metaDescription: This is the best sound healing course in Bali if you want to get level 2/3 sound healing courses at the same time.
summary: Take Level 2 and Level 3 sound healing at the same time, learning the therapeutic use of sound through practical and theoretical sessions.
intro: This course is for you if you want to get level 2/3 sound healing courses at the same time. Our school is located in a peaceful area surrounded by the lush tropical palm trees and rice fields, offering a perfect environment to dive into the transformative world of sound and to connect more deeply with yourself.

This sound healing course is thoughtfully crafted to guide you through the therapeutic use of sound, using instruments like Tibetan singing bowl, gongs, ocean drum, happy drum, rain sticks, and your own voice. You’ll learn how to use the instruments to heal target parts of the body or emotions, and even chakras. Whether you are new to sound healing or wish to deepen your existing practice, this course will give you more than a foundation level of the world of sound healing.

Our dedicated teachers will be with you every step of the way, sharing their expertise and insights through both practical and theoretical sessions. You will dive into the science behind sound healing, understanding its effects on the body and mind, and discover techniques to use sound as a powerful healing modality for yourself and others.

issues: Inclusions promise a 'Level 1&2 Sound Healing Completion Certification' on the Level 2/3 page (copied from the Level 1&2 page) — should presumably be Level 2/3; confirm.

Fees are identical to the Level 1&2 combined course (600/800/700/500 USD offer).
Schedule heading 'Dates 2025' / 'throughout the year of 2025' is stale (page captured 2026-10-19); no batch dates.
Intro and meta claim 'This is the best sound healing course in Bali' — unverified marketing claim, removed from intro.
Intro lists gongs, happy drum and 'your own voice' as instruments; gong and voice are not in the Level 2/3 syllabus.
Booking text is self-contradictory: 'deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD' and refers to 'yoga retreat fees'.
Self-practice policy refers to 'HYA Healing Studio' (Rishikesh sister-school name) — likely copied text.
'OUR YOGA CERTIFICATIONS' block claims IYO accreditation / IYS recognition; inclusions say certified by International Yoga Organisation & Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society — confirm.
Page contains 'Physical / Mental / Spiritual Effects of Sound Healing' list with unverified medical claims — not extracted.
